lines: In three seven thousands two-hundred thus rising held; in four but thousands five and indeed four-hundred.
l4.sanskrit_cite: trike sapta sahasrāṇi dviśatītyudayo mataḥ catuṣke tu sahasrāṇi pañca caiva catuḥśatī
